text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 30, "unit": "minutes", "kind": "count", "span": "30 minutes to cook rice"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 20, "unit": "minutes", "kind": "count", "span": "20 more minutes"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "half (implied divisor)"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "pork time = rice time + 20 more minutes"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "combined cooking time of pork and rice"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s2", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "beans took half the combined pork+rice time"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "total time = pork+rice combined plus beans"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "total minutes to cook all the food (rice, pork, and beans)"}, "dismissed": []}
